title: The Winter Market

intro.speaker: greta
intro.text: Welcome to Bellhaven, my dear! Sam told me you'd come. The winter market opens today!

intro.speaker: greta
intro.text: Would you please stock my stall? Here's my list. Read it carefully, and put just what it says on the table.

steps.speaker: greta
steps.prompt: Read the list. Put the right things on the stall, then press Done.

older.prompt: Read the list: no pictures this time. Put the right things on the stall, then press Done.

feedback.all_good: My stall looks wonderful! Just what the list said.

outro.speaker: greta
outro.text: Now we're ready for customers! Look how the lanterns are going up along the high street.

journal_line: I stocked Mrs. Greta's stall for Bellhaven's winter market.
